arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys,json,base64,subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,'deps')
import zstandard as zstd
HDR='type,id,revision,published,op,lease,event,probe,target,responder,result,service,attempt,payload\n'
GOOD=HDR+'icmp,a,0,1,put,h,1,0/i1,2001:db8:1:1200::1,2001:db8:1:1200::1,echo,,,\n'
job={'version':3,'seed':'x','leases':[{'id':'h','prefix':'2001:db8:1:1200::/56','start':0,'end':100,'subnets':[0],'low_count':1}],'services':[],'queries':[10],'captures':[],'requests':[],'offers':[],'request_quotas':[],'offer_quotas':[]}
c=zstd.ZstdCompressor();d=bytearray(c.compress(GOOD.encode()));d[4]|=0x10
job['captures']=[{'encoding':'zstd','chunks':[base64.b64encode(bytes(d)).decode()]}]
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/submission/campaign.py'],input=json.dumps(job).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
print(p.stdout[:500])
EOF
